# Grid

The Grid field in ExpressionEngine provides a way to group fieldtypes in repeatable rows. This is useful for when you need to group a subset of data in your channel entry form that may or may not have a varying number of rows. You can select a minimum and a maximum amount of rows to allow data entry for, or it can be virtually infinite.

:::note
The following examples use a field named `grid_field` as well as columns named `column_1` and `column_2`. These should be replaced with your field and column names.
:::

<Tabs groupId="template-language">
<TabItem value="twig" label="Twig">

```twig
{% for row in entry.grid_field %}
    {{ row.column_1 }}
    {{ row.column_2 }}
{% endfor %}
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem value="blade" label="Blade">

```php
@foreach($entry->grid_field as $row)
    {{ $row->column_1 }}
    {{ $row->column_2 }}
@endforeach
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>


## Parameters

<Tabs groupId="template-language">
<TabItem value="twig" label="Twig">

```twig
{% for row in entry.grid_field.parameters({sort: 'desc', limit: 2}) %}
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem value="blade" label="Blade">

```php
@foreach($entry->grid_field->parameters(['sort' => 'desc', 'limit' => 2]) as $row)
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>

:::info
See the ExpressionEngine Documentation for more information on the [Grid fieldtype](https://docs.expressionengine.com/latest/fieldtypes/grid.html)
:::
